full_name: Lamia Joreige | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Arts Rita E. Hauser Fellow Independent Artist (Lebanon)
bio: Lamia Joreige is a visual artist and filmmaker whose practice involves the use of archival documents and fictitious elements to reflect on the relationship between individual stories and the collective history of Lebanon and the Middle East.
